verdict.rationale: Retell's own docs say a single- or multi-prompt agent can connect to a remote MCP server and call that server's tools during a live voice or chat conversation. That directly delivers MCP servers as tool sources used mid-call. Retell's separate MCP server for building agents from Cursor or Claude is a different capability and is not credited here. Missing for 10: detail on configuration, auth and tool selection or filtering for the connected server; whether node-based conversation-flow agents are supported (only single and multi-prompt agents are named); independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my voice agent can plug in MCP servers as tool sources so one integration grants it whole toolsets mid-call

citations.quote: Connect your single- or multi-prompt agent to a remote Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, and the agent can call that server's tools during a live call.
Connect a Retell single- or multi-prompt agent to a remote MCP server so it can call the server's tools during a live voice or chat conversation.
